page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top: "Cap.6." at left and "AVGVSTINVS" at right. No margin notes. Catchword at the lower right: "habue-".

main_text.p: care,nec iterum in alia corpora mitti. Sed quasi iam non satis esset erroris in ipsa Gnosticorū hæresi,addidit librarius in transcribendo errorem,ut in ipso errore intelligendo pene ipsi eraremus. Huius autem erroris fundamentum & causam sumpserunt Gnostici,ut scribit Hieronymus in Galat.1. vers.15. quòd cùm alij sint electi à Deo: alij reprobati antequam aliquid boni fecerint aut mali:hoc iuste à Deo fieri non posset, nisi esset pereuntium, & saluandorū diversa natura: in unis spiritualis,in aliis carnalis[?]. 3 Angelos ex summo Patre & Æone procreatos, quibus nomina barbara imponunt. Septem autem genitos cocubitu humano. Hoc à superioribus hæresibus sumptū est. 4 Duplicem Deum primi illi falsissimè induxerunt, unum bonum:alterum malum. Hinc Manichæi fæces suas apertissimè depropserunt. 5 Christum distinguunt, ut aliam personam, à Iesu. Descendisse enim Christum in Iesum iam natum,& grādem,& pene triginta annorum,quo primum tepore cœpit miracula edere. Demum autem post resurrectione unitū esse Christum Iesu. Irenæus. Hinc Nestorianismi & Eutychianismi vetustissima & venenosissima femina,quę postea excitauit, & robustius germinare fecit Satan. 6 Christum post resurrectionem per octodecim menses hic in mundo versatum citra manifestissimam Scripturę fidem. Act.1.v.3. Irenæus. 7 Martyria negarūt pro nomine Dei subeunda Christianis. Tertullianus. 8 Imagines Christi depictas coluerunt, & in summa veneratione,ut gentes,suorū deorum picturas habue-

page.notes: The word "carnalis" is partly obscured in the scan ("ca: nalis"); the reading is doubtful and marked [?]. The printed u/v and long s were normalised as instructed; the printed macrons on "Gnosticorū", "saluandorū", "grādem", "unitū" and "Negarūt" are kept as printed. The line-end break "Eutychia / nifmi" is read as "Eutychianismi" without a hyphen, since none is printed. The paragraph runs from the top of the page to the catchword, with no printed paragraph breaks visible. The numbers 3 to 8 sit mid-paragraph and are not headings.
